info.title: Finance Status Notifier Application
info.description: This app will be consumed by Finance system to push the processing status of the files generated by the finance adapters.

put.summary: Operation to push the file processing status from the Finance system
put.description: This is the operation to push the file processing status from the Finance system to have all the relevant status related information colocated in document db

404.description: Adapter entry for desired file could not found

get.summary: Retrieves configuration details monitored by the Spring config watcher
get.description: Retrieves configuration details monitored by the Spring config watcher

post.description: This operation changes the ROOT log level of the app

post.summary: Operation to create/load the performance test data to the respective docdb collection based on the count provided for each adapter
post.description: This is to create/load adapter processing status data to perform performance testing based on input count for each adapter provided it is enabled for the environment. It will return the array of property codes for which the data has been created. Property codes should be in the format of GLXXX and BTXXX where XXX is any combination of alphabets only.

requestBody.description: Request body detailing what data and how much needs to be created

200.description: Returns an array of property codes for which data is created

400.description: Error Ocurred while loading the data in the DB

404.description: The data endpoint is not available for this environment

delete.summary: Operation to delete performance test data based on the adapter list provided in the request body
delete.description: This operation deletes the documents from the document database for the specified adapters.

parameters.name: adapters
parameters.description: List of adapters for which the performance test data should be deleted

404.description: The data endpoint is not available for this environment

propertyCode.description: Property code or Marsha Code. It is optional in case of OFB.

businessDate.description: Business date or Transaction posting date

errorCode.description: Error code that caused the file processing to fail

errorDescription.description: Error code that caused the file processing to fail

databaseId.description: Database name. It confirms where the message came from, particularly useful for the environments with multiple instances.

processInstance.description: Finance process instance. Identifies the process identifier executed or reported the status

processName.description: Finance process name. PeopleSoft SQR, App Engine or script name

operatorId.description: Finance user ID. The user that executed the Finance process

glCount.description: Count to add the file processing status for GL

btrCount.description: Count to add the file processing status for BTR

items.description: Property code in the format GLXXX, OFXXX, or BTXXX where XXX is any combination of alphabets.
